title: Darkhold Arena (v16)
description: Wave-based arena RPG with character select, upgrade shop, destructible walls, skeleton minions, and now — witches that summon fast red devils from wave 5 onward!
prompt: add a new enemy that spawns from wave 5, make it spawn off the map so its not visible when the player first spawns. The new unit will be a witch so use a small witch looking character. Once the witch spots you it will start spawning little red devils that have fairly low hp but move fast. When killing the witch you get 5 tokens. Have this boss spawn in every wave after and have its health and the little devils health increase slightly each wave.
